conditions.acceptance: provisional; rejected as a percentile baseline, see host_clock_wander
conditions.host_clock_wander: runs 3 to 5 are 8 to 25 per cent slower per tick than runs 1 and 2 while delivering an identical 59.74 items per tick. An earlier collection of the same workload from the same cold start reproduced the same fast-fast-slow-slow-slow ordering. Within a slow run the rate wanders in both directions - run 3 starts at run 1's speed and degrades, runs 4 and 5 start slow and recover - so it is the host's sustained clock rather than the factory's state. The active and blocked collections, which are seven times lighter per tick, show no such spread.
